entries.title: Sai Nitish Reddy Kapa
entries.text: Sai Nitish Reddy Kapa presents himself on this portfolio as an AI builder, product founder, and thriller writer. He builds applied AI products, developer tools, mobile experiences, and intelligent systems, while also writing psychological thrillers.

entries.title: Builder approach
entries.text: The portfolio describes a product philosophy centered on clarity, working evidence, emotional design, and long-term foundations. Nitish prefers tested flows and inspectable systems over impressive sounding promises.

entries.title: Vakya
entries.text: Vakya is a privacy-first real-time translation and subtitle assistant spanning a Chrome extension, realtime speech pipeline, web surfaces, and an Android path. Its verified demo path includes draggable subtitles, explicit tab-audio consent, demo/live modes, and realtime WebSocket support.

entries.title: Circuit
entries.text: Circuit is an AI career learning and simulation platform with 300 learner-visible lessons across five tracks and 15,600 versioned SQL, DSA, and Forward-Deployed practice items, plus simulations and evidence-backed proof artifacts.

entries.title: AppGraft
entries.text: AppGraft is a company-first software capability platform that maps repositories, evaluates reusable capabilities, creates adaptation and rollback contracts, validates changes in isolation, and prepares human-reviewed draft pull requests with provenance and proof.

entries.title: Syrava Edge
entries.text: Edge is a local-first model studio built around collect, train, inspect, test, and export. It trains compact text classifiers locally, exposes holdout and label-level evidence, and exports offline JavaScript or TypeScript inference packages.

entries.title: Unsaid
entries.text: Unsaid is a private reflection and journaling product for writing what should not be sent. It combines venting and journaling with an AI companion, safety checks, data export, and native iOS and Android shells through Capacitor.

entries.title: Thriller writing
entries.text: Nitish writes psychological thrillers focused on pressure, hidden motives, fractured relationships, moral ambiguity, and the decisions people make when comfortable options disappear.

entries.title: Contact
entries.text: The portfolio lists kapasainitishreddy@gmail.com as Nitish's direct contact email and links to his GitHub profile at github.com/kapasainitishreddy.
